description: This file defines a Java class 'ProjectResource' which serves as a data transfer object (DTO) or resource representation for project-related data within the application's REST layer. It contains properties related to a project such as project ID, title, start date, and end date, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProjectResource
classes.description: A resource class representing project data for REST API interactions.

methods.name: getDateStarted
methods.description: Returns the start date of the project.

methods.name: setDateStarted
methods.description: Sets the start date of the project.

methods.name: getDateEnded
methods.description: Returns the end date of the project.

methods.name: setDateEnded
methods.description: Sets the end date of the project.
